answer: Settlement verification clusters cross-address embeddings: each agent must show 120 attested jobs across 40 distinct peers over 90 days, with a 150 POA bond per identity. One honest agent builds 1 embedding cluster from real work; 10 fakes must fabricate 10 disjoint clusters with matching rhythm and latency, multiplying compute and coordination cost tenfold. Peers recompute embeddings from logs, slash the bond and freeze hollow shells, so a wharf of copied identities cannot dock beside a tundra of real history.
